brief.text: Make the Genobi teaser: two minutes of the studio in use, cut to the owner's track Trailer-Genobi at its own tempo, built like the Dimensions mix (a cut written as data that the Director renders). Go through the studio's functions so the viewer sees it work: zoom in, click, focus boxes, loaders and generated titles, and land the owner's generations on the drops. End on the Genobi end card with the music credit. Nothing is generated, quoted or paid for.
